articles.title: Ontology Extraction Pipeline V2 Goes Live, Automating Code-to-Knowledge-Graph Translation
articles.body: The system can now automatically read business concepts directly from the codebase and persist them as a queryable knowledge graph, making our architecture self-documenting. Four sessions culminated in a fully operational V2 extraction pipeline, which ran end-to-end to process 141 concepts into domain-specific spec.yaml files and persist 207 embeddings into the database. This is underpinned by a critical architectural decision: the spec.yaml files are always generated from code tags and dictionaries, never maintained by hand, ensuring the graph is a direct reflection of reality. This unlocks the next layer of agent capabilities, enabling semantic search and direct code-base analysis, and formally deprecates the old ontology-registry.json system.

articles.title: Audit Uncovers Critical Concurrency Gaps; Data Corruption Path Open in Production Code
articles.body: A test audit identified four critical, untested execution paths in production code that create a direct risk of data corruption, specifically duplicating financial records or emitting double events. The gaps center on Celery task redelivery and concurrent database writes (select_for_update) during the remessa approval lifecycle. An event that causes a task to be re-run could bypass idempotency checks, leading to severe financial reconciliation failures. This is a high-priority risk requiring immediate implementation of integration tests to cover these concurrency scenarios before the related feature branch is merged. A separate red test suite in the semantic index (5 failures) should also be treated as a release gate.

articles.title: Foundational Domain Tagging Pass Completed, Making the Entire Codebase Semantically Legible
articles.body: The entire codebase is now mapped to the business ontology, providing the essential raw data for the new V2 extraction pipeline. This session executed the first full-codebase tagging plan, adding 64 new @biz and @sys tags across all five business domains and infrastructure code. Before this, large sections of the system were effectively dark to automated analysis. This work transforms the codebase from opaque source files into a structured, machine-readable asset, a non-negotiable prerequisite for all current and future knowledge graph capabilities.

articles.title: Remessa Test Suites Stabilized, Unblocking Core Financial Operations Feature Path
articles.body: A series of failing frontend and backend tests that were blocking the `remessa` implementation plan have been resolved, turning the entire suite green. The session addressed a range of issues from migration wiring and test-contract drift to an environment-specific failure in the Vitest runner related to `globalThis.crypto`. The immediate business result is that development and validation of core acquisition and liquidation features can now proceed without impediment, removing a key blocker from the critical path.

articles.title: Unusable 'Check Status' Page Restored via Gunicorn and Query Optimization
articles.body: The previously non-functional 'Check Status' page is now fully operational for developers, with load times reduced from over 100 seconds to under 3 seconds. An investigation revealed the root cause was not a token or CORS issue as previously suspected, but a misconfigured development server (docker-compose.dev.yml) running Gunicorn with a single synchronous worker thread, causing requests to time out under minimal load. This fix restores a key operational view for monitoring contract status in the development environment.
